questions.q: Identify the part of speech of “since” in: “She has not called since.”
questions.why: It has no object or clause following, so it is an adverb meaning 'from then till now'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “All ____ glitters is not gold.”
questions.why: After 'all', the relative pronoun 'that' is used. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “She is one of the best doctors who has served in this hospital.”
questions.why: In 'one of the ... who', the relative pronoun refers to the plural 'doctors': 'have served'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: “The ____ surgeon was honoured with a national award.”
questions.why: 'Eminent' means distinguished; 'imminent' means about to happen. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct version: “The reason is because he was ill.”
opts: The reason is that he was ill.
The reason is for he was ill.
The reason is why he was ill.
The reason is due to that he was ill.
questions.why: 'The reason is' is followed by a 'that' clause, not 'because'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: “It is two years since he ____ smoking.”
questions.why: 'It is (time) since' is followed by the simple past. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the correct form: “If I weren’t so busy these days, I ____ the conference last week.”
questions.why: Mixed conditional: present state, past result. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Identify the error: “He is a such brilliant student that everyone admires him.”
questions.why: The order is 'such a' + adjective + noun: 'such a brilliant student'. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Choose the meaning of the idiom “a Pyrrhic victory”:
opts: a victory won at too great a cost
questions.why: After King Pyrrhus, whose victory cost him most of his army. GPSC-style practice item.
